meta.expect: FOLLOW-UP EMAIL then DEBRIEF after the exact phrase, not before

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, and I'd like to know why my son's mark was changed to a zero before anyone called me.
I didn't come for thanks. I came for an answer. Who decided to enter the zero, and on what basis?
I want to walk you through what I found in the version history.
You still haven't answered who decided. Show me the document itself, with dates on it, and I'll read it myself.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Subject: Owen Kalinowski, English 30-1 essay mark
To: Mr./Ms. Hale
Cc: Principal

Hale,

I met with you today at 4:15 about the zero entered on Owen's Hamlet essay. I asked who decided to enter it and on what basis. I did not get an answer.

You said you wanted to walk me through the version history. You did not show it to me.

Your own procedure, 4.2, requires a parent to be contacted before any mark consequence is entered. Nobody called me. Procedure 4.3 says detection software alone does not establish a concern.

I want the zero withdrawn, a written confirmation that nothing is on Owen's record, and any documents you are relying on, with dates, by 9 AM Thursday. If I don't have them, I will ask the principal for a review under 4.6 and take it to the board after that.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Rung reached: 0. She did not move, because you showed no document and never answered who decided to enter the zero.
Moved at: none.
Slipped at: "I want to walk you through what I found in the version history." You announced evidence without showing it, and you skipped owning the zero entered before the call home.
